description:
The ServiceNow Developer is responsible for understanding, designing, developing, configuring, updating, and maintaining modular, reusable solutions on the ServiceNow platform in support of HCHB business initiatives. This role partners closely with platform owners, architects, administrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-focused solutions across ITSM, CSM, and related ServiceNow capabilities.
 The ideal candidate combines strong platform development experience with modern AI-assisted development practices, including the ability to leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation tooling, and agentic AI products, to accelerate delivery and improve solution quality. This role requires strong collaboration skills, adaptability, and a continuous learning mindset to support the evolving ServiceNow ecosystem.
  
 JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Align ServiceNow platform capabilities to business strategy and ServiceNow roadmap

 Develop, test, and implement new capabilities on the ServiceNow platform

 Assist with ServiceNow upgrades, action skipped changes, and create/run tests

 Stay current on ServiceNow products and applicable integrated technologies

 EXPERTISE AND EXPERIENCE: 
 3+ years as a ServiceNow Developer with experience developing in the following areas:

 ITSM: Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog

 Service Portals

 Flow Designer, Workflow, Virtual Agent Topics, Integration Hub

 Application integrations using APIs, web services, scripts, transform maps, etc.

 Scoped Applications

 Scripting in ServiceNow

 Test Management and ATF

 ITOM: Event Management, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping

 1+ years as member of an Agile, Scrum, or Kanban team

 Broad general knowledge of IT infrastructure topology including typical application, server, and networking configurations

 Knowledge of the ITIL framework especially as it pertains to the CMDB model and governance

 Comprehension of the ServiceNow CSDM model

 Experience designing and deploying AI solutions on and off the ServiceNow platform, with strong AI prompt engineering skills

 Strong communication skills that include the ability to write clearly and concisely

 Knowledge of database fundamentals

 ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE (not required): 
 CSM: Case Management, Agent Workspace, Communities

 Performance Analytics, Dashboards

 Workspaces

 Reporting

 Active Directory/PowerShell

 Transform Maps

 AI Control Tower

 EDUCATION / CERTIFICATION / TRAINING  
 Bachelor's degree in a technical field (or equivalent experience)

 ServiceNow System Administration

 Any of the following certifications are a plus:
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer

 ITIL Foundations

 ServiceNow Discovery Fundamentals

 ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Discovery

 ServiceNow Advanced System Administration

 Scripting in ServiceNow

 CCNA or equivalent 

 MCSA, RHCSA (Microsoft, RedHat)

 
  
 About Us 
 Homecare Homebase, a subsidiary of Hearst Corporation is a market leader in healthcare software development providing mobile cloud-based solutions for clinical, operational, and financial improvement of homecare and hospice agencies throughout the United States.  Our software enables real time solutions for wireless information exchange and communication between office staff, field staff, and physicians. 
 Our success is fueled by our talented technology teams that are driven by their passion to make a difference in patient care.  Our employees work in a culture that is guided by values of caring, action, respect, excellence, and smile (a positive attitude).  If you want to work in a role where your skills have a direct influence on patient care, Homecare Homebase is the next step in your career.  We are hiring technologists that want to make a difference. 
  
 This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the US without immigration sponsorship.
